exact_statement: For every finite fixed rational gate table with nonempty supports, positive normalized dictionary-size and local-subset laws, the dictionary-first generator and its finite output quotient admit computable prefix decoders with each selected gate name occurring once in the record and canonical roots/attachments requiring no extra fields. On the sunflower f_m=x0-(1+x0)*prod_i(1-x_i)/2 for every integer m>=1, the specified normalized output reference has nonempty spectral expected ideal cost <25I(f_m)/4 and full-output prefix expected length <33I(f_m)/4; raw latent-record cost is at least (1-2^-m)^2 log2(m). Ordinary addressing has a dedicated exact 2a-bit code.
hypotheses: uniform sign cube for Boolean application
fixed rational structural model known to encoder and decoder
dictionary subset laws positive on all nonempty local subsets
sample-dependent model selection is paid by a fixed normalized prior
output quotient need not recover original latent record

review_records.method: Independent four-state dictionary trace pushforward and complete analytic proof reconstruction; author checker not imported

exact_statement: For every odd integer n>=1, let k=(n+1)/2 and Maj_n be uniform majority. Its positive prime-implicant table consists of every k-subset conjunction, with one cover ordered by a common physical order, lambda_R=1/binom(n-1,k-1), pi_R=2^(-k), and gamma=6/5. The conditioned posterior residual optimized over distinct actual finite partition-forest runs is at most [49/5+(6/5)*log2(e)]*I(Maj_n), strictly less than (58/5)*I(Maj_n) and at most (58/5)*sqrt(n). An admissible certificate uses the uniform posterior over all single-root containing-clause runs when |A|<=k, and one actual two-clause partition run with alternating ownership and one attachment when |A|>k. The same table construction, for an arbitrary Boolean spectrum, gives residual <=(43/5)*I+(6/(5*ln2))*E G(A), where G(A)=sum_{j in A}ln(j/(|A intersect [j-1]|+1)); the majority rank bound is E G<= (1+ln2)*I. No universal rank payment or all-Boolean PI-J bound is asserted.
hypotheses: uniform cube and bits for entropy/cost; natural units for G
all positive prime implicants of odd majority; globally fixed support table and fractional weights
partition subsets disjoint; every used gate visited exactly once; chronological child labels define actual run identity
failed/infinite runs omitted and reference conditioned on nonempty initial roots
no output-dependent reference-table or scale selection
